objective: On complete bounded game domains, test predefined rank-local candidate representations for future-behavior and scalar-value sufficiency, while independently validating q_o transition closure.
candidate_families: q_o full oriented support + owned residual antichains
q_r physical horizontal-reflection orbit of q_o
falsification_rule: Any collision whose members have different target semantics falsifies that candidate for the tested sufficiency target.
positive_rule: Zero collisions on a finite bounded domain is exact for that domain only unless backed by a separate theorem.
recursive_channel: Independently derive q_o child state from q_o + literal action + G and require exact match to every physical child q_o.
direct_channel: Predeclared algebraic summaries are current-position-only candidate inputs; collision counterexamples falsify them without implying no other direct evaluator exists.
prohibited_information_sources: external solved database as producer input
